completion_estimate_meaning: No yes/no resolution established; this is not a calibrated probability.
exact_gap: No construction of a complete two-dimensional image contained in M_4(C), and no universal nonexistence proof. The five routes only impose necessary conditions or exclude specified construction mechanisms.
exact_target: Existence of an integral proper complex surface in the coarse moduli space M_4 of smooth unmarked connected projective genus-four curves; singular surfaces allowed.
